comments: crates/blit-cli/src/transfers/local.rs:613 — The timeout only drops the handle for a started spawn_blocking task already blocked in writer.join(); such tasks are unabortable, and the #[tokio::main] runtime waits for them during shutdown, so a wedged writer can still hang CLI exit.

crates/blit-cli/src/transfers/local.rs:618 — finish_and_clear() still runs synchronously in the async task after the timeout; indicatif acquires the same ProgressBar state lock and performs terminal I/O, so a writer wedged while holding that lock can hang finish() directly.
